purpose: R5 (DR 0017 / DR 0021 Review step): record a creature's live_cycle as a replay artifact of per-tick engine truth — birth/wound/repair packets plus every episode tick — for the workshop preview's scrubber.

decision.reason: A creature's whole life scrubs as recorded engine truth: the wound frames are the damage events' own observability records, the bodies are validator-passed render packets, and every episode tick is the lifecycle's own history entry. Nothing is synthesized for display.

next_research_step: The preview scrubber consumes this artifact live (/api/preview/replay); R6's replay_100k_ticks dataset batches this recorder over the corpus.
